title: Scratch Runner UTF-8 Stream Codec & SysPath Precedence Protocol
author: Brain Harness Reflector & Mind Reader

claims.assertion: Reconfiguring standard streams to UTF-8 at the top of scratch runner scripts prevents Windows cp1252 charmap encoding crashes on Unicode table borders and card symbols.
Injecting workspace root and src/ into sys.path[0] eliminates ModuleNotFoundError on harness and plugins when executing scripts from brain artifact directories.
Doubling braces {{ }} in Python f-strings containing CSS styles or Regex rules prevents string format syntax errors during HTML visual brief generation.
